title: Implement gossipsub backpressure and message rate limiting
description:
Implement per-peer outbound queue with configurable depth. If a peer's queue is full, new messages for that peer are dropped and a metric counter is incremented. Implement a per-hierarchy publish rate limiter (token bucket) to prevent a single group from flooding the mesh. Artifact: transit/src/gossip/backpressure.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Queue depth and token bucket rate are configurable from TOML
- Dropped messages increment a Prometheus counter (gossip_messages_dropped_total)
- No deadlock or unbounded memory growth under sustained high-rate publish
- Unit test: publish at 10x rate limit, verify drops are counted and queue doesn't grow unboundedly
